note: Kith training at Thornwick (src/kith/training.ts). One drill per attribute. A drill set for a kith runs every day it has the energy; the player can attend it in person and play it (src/ui/trainingScene.ts), which is the only way to reach Great or Perfect. 'pens' is the pens level it needs; 'energy' what a session costs; 'trait' the technique a first Perfect teaches; 'mood' the music track; 'backdrop' the stage.

drills.name: Heave the stone sledge
drills.text: A sledge of quarry stone on a rope across the yard. Brannoc's old way: heave on the swing, never against it.
drills.how: A needle swings across the gauge. Press when it's in the gold to heave. Gold is a strong pull, the edges a weak one. Miss and the kith loses its footing.

drills.name: The long carry
drills.text: Panniers of wet sand down the Thornwick road and back, at the drover's pace and no faster.
drills.how: Hold to push the pace up, let go to ease off. Keep the marker inside the drover's band as it moves. Pushing too long tires it.

drills.name: The ledge run
drills.text: Down the scree below the bathhouse, three tracks wide, with loose rock coming down from above.
drills.how: Up and Down change track. Press to leap a gap. Fallen rock and gaps come at you faster as it goes.

drills.name: Drums and smoke
drills.text: A drum beats, smoke pots go off, a sheet snaps on a line. The kith has to hold where it stands.
drills.how: Each fright shoves its nerve one way. Left and Right steady it back to the middle. Keep the needle in the calm band.

drills.name: Scent cups
drills.text: A dried cloudberry under one of the cups. The cups move. The kith has to follow it, and so do you.
drills.how: Watch the cup with the berry. When they stop, Left and Right choose, press to lift. Each round they move faster.

drills.name: Call and answer
drills.text: Rhea hums a phrase of the foal song across the field. The kith learns to come to it, and to answer.
drills.how: Listen and watch the notes, then hum them back in order with the arrow keys. Each phrase is one note longer.

drills.name: The show ring
drills.text: Round the ring before the whole post: stand, turn, head up, step out, all on the drum.
drills.how: Cues slide to the line on the beat. Press the matching arrow as each one crosses it.
